readings.title: Kernel Alignment Risk Estimator: Risk Prediction from Training Data
read_locators: pp1-8 title and main-body KRR setup, AssumptionA, theorem statements, proof sketches and KARE relation; p8 graph labels visually checked
source_facts: p1/p4: fixed-kernel ridge closed-form predictor with squared risk under iid observation-functionals and independent additive noise.
p5 AssumptionA: proofs use Gaussian observations / universality premise for first two moments at large finite N.
pp7-8 Theorem6/7 approximate expected squared risks; converting their relation to sample KARE adds concentration assumptions.
limits: pp9-41, full Appendix proofs and code not audited; no source numerical reproduction.
No established transfer from fixed-KRR solve to label-learned per-class normalized Born attention with jointly learned signed decoder.
KARE does not supply a native CE/Macro generalization estimate or remove need for independent empirical validation.
